Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/), Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display

penguins = sns.load_dataset("penguins")
```

```{python}
#| label: penguins-top-10-rows

display(penguins.head(10))
```

```{python}
#| label: penguins-describe

penguins.describe()
```

## Dropping out the NA's in the dataset

```{python}
#| label: clean-data-py

penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=["body_mass_g", "flipper_length_mm", "species", "sex"])

penguins_clean.isna().sum()
```

## Some grouped analysis on the mean mass and flipper length for each species and sex.

```{python}
#| label: grouped-summary-py

penguins_grouped = (
    penguins_clean
    .groupby(["species", "sex"])
    .agg(
        mean_mass=("body_mass_g", "mean"),
        mean_flipper=("flipper_length_mm", "mean"),
        n=("body_mass_g", "count")
    )
)

penguins_grouped
```

## Adding a new column for Mass Ratio (Body Mass/Flipper Length)

```{python}
#| label: derived-variable-py

penguins_clean["mass_ratio"] = penguins_clean["body_mass_g"] / penguins_clean["flipper_length_mm"]

penguins_clean.head()
```

## Box Plot for Mass Ratio of penguins by species

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass-py
#| fig-cap: "Mass Ratio of penguins by species."

sns.boxplot(data=penguins_clean, x="species", y="mass_ratio")
plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Mass Ratio")
plt.show()
```
